slides.title: Signs your house is ADHD-coded (be honest, how many?)
You might have an ADHD house if...
items: There's a chair that only holds clothes
A 'to go upstairs' pile lives on the stairs
3 open bottles of the same shampoo
Laundry washed twice, still in the washer
Every drawer is the junk drawer
A bag of returns older than your phone

slides.title: And also...
items: Cabinet doors left open like a crime scene
Mail you're 'dealing with later' since June
Half-done projects on every flat surface
You clean for guests, only for guests
You own 4 of the same tool, can find 0

slides.title: None of this means you're messy
slides.body: It means your home was set up for a brain that remembers things out of sight. Ours doesn't. That's a design problem, not a you problem.

slides.title: The fix is systems, not willpower
slides.body: Visible storage, fewer steps, homes near where stuff lands. Make the easy thing the tidy thing.

slides.title: My house isn't dirty. It's a museum of things I was about to do.
Ready to un-code it?
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset is a 7-day shame-free plan built for exactly this house. Link in bio.
